{{Quote|Mind your place, trooper. I am your superior officer, and I have friends in high places.''"<br />"''No doubt. We're getting out of here. Let's move!|Kendal Ozzel and Spitter|<ref name="The Clone Wars 8">[[The Clone Wars 8|''The Clone Wars'' 8]]</ref>}}
'''Spitter''' was a [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|clone cold assault trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Around [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Spitter served under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] during the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of Khorm]] where they take action against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. When Fisto and Koon withdrew to destroy the Separatist weather-control station, Spitter remained with [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tauht]] in a Republic camp until they were later ambushed by [[Battle droid/Legends|Battle droids]] under the command of [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. Surviving the attack, Spitter, along with [[Comet (clone trooper)/Legends|Comet]], [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]] and [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]], were captured and taken to a Separatist base that was controlled by the [[Khormai/Legends|Khormai]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Unger Gout]]. Later, they were able to break free and escape in an [[Armored Assault Tank/Legends|Armored Assault Tank]].
